skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 800% ATK DMG. The first strike has a 50% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] and [Weaken] on the target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 600% of Gouketsu’s ATK as Internal Injury DMG and disappears after triggering. [Weaken]: Decreases the target’s ATK by 50% for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 1000% ATK DMG. The first strike has an 80% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] and [Weaken] on the target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 800% of Gouketsu’s ATK as Internal Injury DMG and disappears after triggering. [Weaken]: Decreases the target’s ATK by 50% for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains a 60% chance of [Evasion]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates on [Internal Injury]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG. [Detonate]: Converts a single [Internal Injury] DMG instance equal to 300% ATK into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains a 70% chance of [Evasion]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates on [Internal Injury]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG. [Detonate]: Converts a single [Internal Injury] DMG instance equal to 350% ATK into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains an 80% chance of [Evasion]. After any character acts, [Detonate] activates on [Internal Injury]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG. [Detonate]: Converts a single [Internal Injury] DMG instance equal to 400% ATK into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Grants self and surrounding allies [Specialized Unyielding] and makes them immune to [Breakthrough]. [Specialized Unyielding]: When an affected ally receives fatal DMG, enters the [Specialized Unyielding] state. The state is removed after 5 characters act, then the affected ally restores 100% HP. Each character can activate this effect up to 2 times per battle.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Grants the entire team [Specialized Unyielding] and makes all allies immune to [Breakthrough]. [Specialized Unyielding]: When an affected ally receives fatal DMG, enters the [Specialized Unyielding] state. The state is removed after 5 characters act, then the affected ally restores 100% HP. Each character can activate this effect up to 2 times per battle.

effects.desc: Activate a stack of damage over time or stored [Collapse] to instantly explode, turning it into an instant multiplier (e.g. 3 times the stored damage).
Status that causes the bearer to be unaffected by a certain effect or type of control, such as [Breakthrough], Stun, or Charm.
Floors that each cause a direct, additional, charge, or berserk attack to only deal 1 damage.
Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
Unfavorable effects cause delayed damage, storing additional damage (600-800% of Gouketsu's ST), releasing when the target is hit or when [Detonate].
Removes the target's Resilience shield and increases the attack for that attack.
